title: Can't get the smell out after washing, & laying outside for a few days. Very thin.
text:
Can't get the smell out after washing, & laying outside for a few days. Very thin.. I didn't expect this to have such a strong awful smell , be so thin, and have strings falling off of it!
I put it in a lingerie mesh bag and washed it, but still smelled.
Laid it on the outdoor table for a few days hopping for the smell to dissipate, well it still stinks,
And does not look like its something I would even put on my patio table to use.

The blue stripe is very light in color, and this is not a thick burlap.
I do not recommend this.
